in_marathi.name: Chaitri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Spring, Joyful, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaitri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chaitri is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chaitra' meaning spring or the first month of the Hindu calendar. This name is associated with the arrival of new beginnings, joy, and radiance.
